name: Claude Sheets
desc: Spreadsheet that Claude builds and edits with you
desc_zh: 由 Claude 和你一起搭建、修改的电子表格
solves: Building a model sheet from raw exports takes hours; Claude Sheets drafts the spreadsheet while you check the numbers.
solves_zh: 从原始导出数据搭一张模型表要几个小时，Claude Sheets 先起草，你只管核对数字。
best_for: Finance sends a raw CSV and you need a working budget model before the afternoon review.
best_for_zh: 财务刚发来一份原始 CSV，下午评审前要有一版能用的预算模型。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.anthropic.com/news/product and https://claude.com/resources/arti）。 Beta on all paid plans; off by default on Enterprise. Same launch article as Claude Whiteboards.
